response.overview: Kenny and crew are back for a second round of motorized abuse. Not skipping a beat, the rampage continues from the first AC with a higher budget and level of insanity than the lawyers can keep up with. Racking up fees, fines & jail time, you will see the crew smash, flip, pillage, burn, and utterly destroy themselves, their motorcycles, and personal vehicles for your viewing pleasure! Don't worry about them raising your insurance - they would need a license for that! So sit back, relax, and watch the Adrenalin Crew tear it up once again while they are... AWAITING TRIAL.
response.title: Adrenalin Crew 2: Awaiting Trial
